process_steps.input_state: high purity elements (99.95 wt% elemental purity)

evidence.quote: The alloy ingots with a nominal composition of Fe – 10Cr – 10Co- 6.5Al-xTi-3.4Mo-0.25Zr-0.005B (x = 0, 2, 4 and 6 wt %) were prepared by arc melting with high purity elements (99.95 wt% elemental purity) under a Ti-gettered high purity argon atmosphere (99.999 %). ... The ingots were re-melted more than 10 times for homogeneity and solidified on a water-cooled copper hearth.
The as-cast rod samples were produced by suction casting into a cylindrical copper mold with 3 mm in diameter and 50 mm in length.
To remove the elemental segregation during the casting process, homogenization treatment was carried out at 1,473K for 0.5 h, and air cooling until room temperature.
In addition, aging treatment for the precipitation was carried out at 1073 K for 5h and air-cooled until room temperature.
